items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 59:1
items.html: (To the question) Because Aba and Ima do not couple upon the MAN of the Mazalot to draw the stature of AB, except through the pregnancy of ZON, as above, in the secret of the twenty-two letters and the ten utterances; and therefore it is discerned that ZON, in the pregnancy of Bina, cause Aba and Ima to rise to the GAR of AA and to couple upon the MAN of the Mazalot. Behold, the Mazalot are awakened to be MAN for Aba and Ima, because of the ascent of ZON. (Item 50).
